collection.title: Maserati Quattroporte 2020 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Maserati Quattroporte 2020 onwards will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
